sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.zh: 1986年，多萝西决定搬到洛杉矶。

sentences.en: By now Larry Jr.
sentences.zh: 此时的小拉里

sentences.zh: 已经迷上了健美。

sentences.zh: 黄金健身房的五年会员资格。

sentences.en: Like so many before him, Larry Jr.
sentences.zh: 和许多前人一样，小拉里

sentences.en: had plans to make it big.
sentences.zh: 也有着扬名立万的宏伟计划。

sentences.en: He wanted to be the next Arnold Schwarzenegger.
sentences.zh: 他想成为下一个阿诺德·施瓦辛格。

sentences.en: He was committed too.
sentences.zh: 他也确实付诸了行动。

sentences.en: His trips to Gold's Gym were two hours each way from where he was living.
sentences.zh: 他去黄金健身房单程就要花两个小时，从他住的地方算起。

sentences.en: But after a few years, he realised he wasn't going to make it as a professional bodybuilder.
sentences.zh: 但在几年后，他意识到自己无法在职业健美界闯出一片天。

sentences.en: He let his gym membership expire and looked to other avenues to find his fortune.
sentences.zh: 他任由健身房会员资格过期，开始寻找其他发财的途径。

sentences.en: in 1990 he looked to cash in on the los angeles booming property market
sentences.zh: 1990年，他试图在洛杉矶蓬勃发展的房地产市场分一杯羹

sentences.en: he applied for and was granted a real estate sales license it was granted on the grounds that
sentences.zh: 他申请并获得了房地产销售执照，获批的前提是

sentences.en: he passed a future exam and that he would come up clean on a background check it was the background

sentences.en: It was his first and only arrest at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是他当时唯一的一次被捕记录。

sentences.en: His bodybuilding dream didn't work out and now his planned real estate career was taken away.
sentences.zh: 他的健美梦想破灭了，现在他计划中的房地产事业也被剥夺了。

sentences.en: Larry Jr.
sentences.zh: 小拉里

sentences.en: became down and out.
sentences.zh: 陷入了穷困潦倒的境地。

sentences.en: Instead of taking responsibility, he decided to blame everybody else.
sentences.zh: 他没有承担责任，反而决定把责任推卸给所有人。

sentences.en: He came to resent society and its rules.
sentences.zh: 他开始对社会及其规则充满怨恨。

sentences.en: He decided to move back to Denver with his wife Sharon and his children.
sentences.zh: 他决定和妻子莎朗以及孩子们搬回丹佛。

sentences.en: Larry found alternative methods to try and make it rich.
sentences.zh: 拉里寻找其他方法试图暴富。

sentences.en: He contacted local real estate agents and went through a number of properties that were for sale.
sentences.zh: 他联系了当地的房地产经纪人，看遍了许多待售的房产。

sentences.en: He posed as a prospective buyer.
sentences.zh: 他伪装成潜在的购房者。

sentences.en: He would watch the real estate agent unlock the house's lockbox, which contained the keys, and then he would memorise the combination.
sentences.zh: 他会看着房地产经纪人打开房子的密码箱（里面放着钥匙），然后他会记住密码。

sentences.en: He then placed his own ads in the local paper under a fake name, claiming to have several rental properties available.
sentences.zh: 接着，他在当地报纸上用假名刊登广告，声称有多套出租房源。

sentences.en: People would ring him up and would take the prospective renters to inspect the properties that were actually for sale.
sentences.zh: 人们会打电话给他，而他则会带潜在的租客去实地查看那些实际上正在出售的房屋。

sentences.en: Larry would claim the sale of the house had gone through and the new owners wanted to rent the property out as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 拉里会谎称这栋房子的买卖已经完成，新房东希望尽快把房子租出去。

sentences.en: He accepted down payments for rent and security deposits, but the scam didn't last long.
sentences.zh: 他收取了租金定金和押金，但这场骗局并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: He was arrested.
sentences.zh: 他被捕了。

sentences.en: He was charged with the scam, but he was released pending a sentencing hearing.
sentences.zh: 他被指控犯有诈骗罪，但在等待宣判期间被保释。

sentences.en: Larry was looking at two years in
sentences.zh: 拉里面临着两年的刑期

sentences.en: And in 1988, Emil opened up his own computer business, selling computer parts, offering servicing and repairs, as well as writing some software.

sentences.zh: 在抛弃了丹佛的妻子和孩子后，小拉里·菲利普斯

sentences.zh: 返回洛杉矶，重新与他的死党埃米尔·马塔萨拉诺混在了一起。

sentences.en: Larry had big dreams of a rich, extravagant lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 拉里有着奢华富贵生活的宏伟梦想。

sentences.en: This is a person who used to drive to rich neighbourhoods and park outside of a house he liked and then picture himself living there.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经常开车去富人区，把车停在自己喜欢的房子外面，然后幻想自己住在里面的人。

sentences.en: Larry wouldn't bring anybody into his inner circle without a plan for how he could use them to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 拉里绝不会把任何人带进自己的核心圈子，除非他想好了如何利用对方为自己谋利。

sentences.en: He was the type of person that would try and break people down and build them back up so he could control them.
sentences.zh: 他是那种会试图击垮别人然后再重塑别人以达到控制目的的人。

sentences.en: Larry was the manipulator, Emile was the follower.
sentences.zh: 拉里是操纵者，埃米尔是追随者。

sentences.en: He did whatever Larry said.
sentences.zh: 拉里说什么他就做什么。

sentences.zh: 那是1993年7月20日，他们实施了第一起武装抢劫。

sentences.zh: 他们在科罗拉多州利特尔顿的第一银行分行外伏击了一辆运钞车。

sentences.zh: 接受盘问时，拉里说他把驾照忘在家里了，并报了一个假名。

sentences.zh: 格莱姆斯警长接着问这辆车是谁的，埃米尔回答说是拉里母亲的车。

sentences.en: Sergeant Grimes had already done a check and knew it was actually an airport rental.

sentences.en: Then he heard a thud from inside the car.

sentences.zh: 那是埃米尔把自己的手枪扔在副驾驶座底下的声音。

sentences.zh: 当看到特警队员把车停下时，埃米尔跳出车，退回到雪佛莱后面寻找掩护

sentences.en: So there was only about 30 feet or 10 meters distance between the
sentences.zh: 因此特警队员与埃米尔之间只有大约30英尺或10米的距离

sentences.en: SWAT officers and Emile, and there were three cars in between them.
sentences.zh: 他们之间隔着三辆车

sentences.en: They then engaged in a fierce gun battle.
sentences.zh: 随后他们展开了一场激烈的枪战

sentences.en: Emile was struck several times, but was saved by his body armor yet again.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔多次中弹，但再次被防弹衣救了性命

sentences.en: It didn't take the SWAT officers long to realize that if they fired underneath the vehicles they would be able to hit the legs of Emile, which weren't protected by body armour.
sentences.zh: 特警队员没花多久就意识到，如果他们朝车底射击，就能击中埃米尔没有防弹衣保护的腿部

sentences.en: Their plan worked.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划成功了

sentences.en: They hit Emil multiple times in the legs.
sentences.zh: 他们多次击中埃米尔的腿部

sentences.en: One bullet actually shattered his leg.
sentences.zh: 其中一颗子弹甚至打碎了他的腿

sentences.en: But still, Emil wasn't giving up.
sentences.zh: 但埃米尔仍然没有放弃

sentences.en: He kept trying to fire at the SWAT officers, but SWAT were winning the battle.
sentences.zh: 他继续试图向特警队员开枪，但特警占据了上风

sentences.en: Emil was hit several more times, and eventually they finally stopped him.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔又中了几枪，最终他们彻底制服了他

sentences.en: Emil collapsed dropping his weapon and SWAT pounced on him.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔瘫倒在地，扔掉了武器，特警一拥而上将他制服

sentences.en: That exchange lasted just under two minutes.
sentences.zh: 这场交火持续了不到两分钟

sentences.en: The time was near 10.01am.
sentences.zh: 当时接近上午10点01分

sentences.en: After 44 minutes of mayhem, the North Hollywood shootout was over.
sentences.zh: 经过44分钟的混乱，北好莱坞枪战终于结束了

sentences.en: But the scene was obviously still chaotic.
sentences.zh: 但现场显然依然一团糟

sentences.en: Injured officers and injured civilians everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是受伤的警员和受伤的平民

sentences.en: And the police still weren't entirely sure if they had all the gunmen or if there was still one more on the loose.
sentences.zh: 而且警方仍然不完全确定他们是否抓获了所有枪手，或者是否还有一人在逃

sentences.en: The scene and surrounding areas wouldn't be fully cleared until over 12 hours later.
sentences.zh: 现场及周边地区直到12个多小时后才完全清理完毕

sentences.en: Emile was down but he was still alert.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔倒下了，但他仍然保持清醒

sentences.en: He was placed under the guard of detectives James Wojtekke and officer John Futrell.
sentences.zh: 他被置于侦探詹姆斯·沃伊特克和约翰·富特雷尔警官的看守之下

sentences.en: Emile had been shot 29 times.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔身上中了29枪

sentences.en: He stayed alive for just over an hour but an ambulance never got to him in time and he died at the scene.
sentences.zh: 他又活了一个多小时，但救护车一直没能及时赶到，他在现场死亡

sentences.en: He was aged 30 years old.
sentences.zh: 他时年30岁

sentences.en: A few years later Emile's family filed a civil suit against the LAPD and specifically the two officers who were guarding him.
sentences.zh: 几年后，埃米尔的家属对洛杉矶警察局提起民事诉讼，具体指控看守他的两名警官

sentences.en: The LAPD responded by saying it was standard procedure not to allow paramedics into what was called the hot zone, putting them in danger.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶警察局回应称，不允许急救人员进入被称为交火热区的地方以防他们陷入危险是标准程序

sentences.en: They maintained they were of the belief that there was at least one and possibly more gunmen still on the loose.
sentences.zh: 他们坚称自己当时相信至少有一名甚至更多枪手仍然在逃

sentences.en: It was alleged in the court case that paramedics had made their way to Emile's location while he was still alive but one of the officers told them to leave.
sentences.zh: 诉讼中声称，在埃米尔还活着的时候，急救人员曾设法到达他的位置，但其中一名警官叫他们离开

sentences.en: It is also alleged other paramedics were heading that way but their attendance was cancelled by Officer Futrell over the air.
sentences.zh: 据称还有其他急救人员正赶往那里，但他们的出勤被富特雷尔警官通过无线电取消了

sentences.en: Some people say they deliberately let him die.
sentences.zh: 有些人说他们是故意让他死的

sentences.en: The LAPD maintained
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶警察局坚称

sentences.en: that they were following standard procedure.
sentences.zh: 他们遵循的是标准程序

sentences.en: The jury couldn't decide, the case resulted in a hung jury.
sentences.zh: 陪审团无法达成一致，案件最终成为悬案

sentences.en: After that result Emile's family ended up dropping the civil suit.
sentences.zh: 结果出来后，埃米尔的家属最终撤回了民事诉讼

sentences.en: During that 44 minutes
sentences.zh: 在那44分钟里

sentences.en: Emile and Larry had fired about 1100 rounds, the police had fired about 650 rounds.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔和拉里发射了大约1100发子弹，警察发射了大约650发子弹

sentences.en: over 300 police officers attended in what was a city-wide tactical alert.
sentences.zh: 超过300名警察出动，这是一次全市范围的战术警戒

sentences.en: 32 officers in total fired their weapons at Emile and Larry at one point or another.
sentences.zh: 总共有32名警员在不同时间向埃米尔和拉里开过枪

sentences.en: 17 officers were awarded the
sentences.zh: 17名警员被授予

sentences.en: Medal of Valour, which is the LAPD's highest honour, awarded for bravery or heroism above and beyond the normal demands of police service.
sentences.zh: 勇气勋章，这是洛杉矶警察局的最高荣誉，授予超越警察职责常规要求的勇敢或英雄主义行为

sentences.en: A total of 11 police and seven civilians were injured,
sentences.zh: 总共有11名警察和7名平民受伤

sentences.en: But by some miracle, the only people that lost their lives that day were Larry Phillips Jr.
sentences.zh: 但宛如奇迹一般，那天失去生命的只有小拉里·菲利普斯

sentences.en: and Emile Matasarano.
sentences.zh: 和埃米尔·马塔萨拉诺

sentences.en: Unusable, the black and white are outblown up.
sentences.zh: 无法使用，黑白巡逻车都被打报废了

sentences.en: All the black and whites at the location are unusable.
sentences.zh: 现场所有的黑白巡逻车都无法使用了

sentences.en: They have shots fired.
sentences.zh: 他们遭遇了枪击
